主要内容: On March 22, 2019, Medallion Financial Corp. entered into several Note Purchase Agreements with institutional investors relating to the private placement of its $30 million aggregate principal amount of 8.25% Senior Notes due March 22, 2024. The Notes mature on March 22, 2024 and bear a fixed interest rate of 8.25% per year. Interest payments are payable semiannually on March 22 and September 22 of each year, starting on September 22, 2019. The Notes are unsecured and unsubordinated, ranking pari passu with the Company's existing and future unsecured and unsubordinated indebtedness. The net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including repayment of indebtedness. The press release announcing the Note Purchase Agreements and the Notes was issued on March 26, 2019.
